name: netrunner-cards-json
notes: Canonical NSG catalog for pack extracts. Prefer a commit SHA on main (not a floating branch). To bump: set `ref` to the new SHA (or annotated tag), clear tmp/nsg-catalog/, then re-run scripts/nsg_catalog.py fetch <pack> / generate-*.py. Effect IR remains hand-authored in this repo. (Formerly nrdb-catalog-pin.json / nrdb_catalog.py — names updated to match NSG source.)
